newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - February 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - February 12.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's Daily Variety:

* "The English Patient," by Walt Disney-owned Miramax led the race for the 69th annual Academy Awards with 12 bids, including best picture, actor, actress, supporting actress, director and writer. The other film nominees are Gramercy's "Fargo" and Fine Line's "Shine" and two films that received five each: "Jerry Maguire" by Sony's TriStar and October Films' "Secrets & Lies."
* Arnold Schwarzenegger has departed ICM, ending a 15-year professional relationship.

* Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Inc Chairman Frank Mancuso has picked New Regency Prods. Chairman and Chief Executive Michael Nathanson to head up MGM Pictures. Nathanson replaces Mike Marcus, who departed the post last week. Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer is owned by investor Kirk Kerkorian.
